propositions: A commit with a body line exceeding 72 characters must be rejected locally, with each offending line named and its length reported.
A commit with a subject exceeding 50 characters must be rejected locally.
A conforming commit must succeed and still receive its Gerrit Change-Id trailer, with the existing commit-msg hook chained as commit-msg.legacy rather than clobbered.
Body lines matching trailer, tag, fenced code block, indented literal block (4+ spaces or tab), table row, or atomic token patterns must be exempt from the 72-column check.
The make hooks target must verify both pre-commit and commit-msg hook installation, exit non-zero if either is missing, and warn (but exit zero) if Change-Id stamping is not found.
Git scaffolding (comment lines and git commit --verbose diff) and the commit message itself must never be mutated by the checker.
